body.message: Good afternoon. I came yesterday and met Mr. Ahmed Jafer your accountant who confirmed me that approval of the transfer of my security deposit was expected yesterday since as he told me the CEO approves all the transactions Monday or Thursday, which obviously didn’t happen. If the money won’t be received by today then I will handover the case to my lawyer. Is not about the 1500 but a matter of all this communication and false reasoning and commitment. It’s a shame to chase so many days for such a small amount which you had the obligation to return by now. Please confirm and by hiding and sending automated replies won’t help. Thank you
